events.text: Standing instruction for the workshop: any parts order over 350 needs Priya Nair's sign-off before we confirm it with the supplier.
House rule: once a customer's collection slot is booked and confirmed, we only change the date or time with that customer's agreement — no silent moves.
Price update: sapphire crystals are 12 each, any quantity.
Renewed the shop insurance for another year — papers in the drawer under the counter.
Approved the sapphire crystal order — 480 to Brisk Supplies, go ahead and confirm.
Ordered 40 sapphire crystals from Brisk Supplies at 12 each, 480 in total, with Priya's sign-off on file.
The 40 sapphire crystals were delivered this morning to the workshop.
Mara Quist's bracelet clasp repair is finished and waiting in the drawer.
Booked Mara Quist to collect her repaired bracelet clasp at the front counter on 3 July at 11:00.
Stock count: 12 sapphire crystals, 8 gasket sheets and 4 leather straps left.
Leather straps are 9 each from this month.
Thanks for fixing the clasp so quickly — it looks brand new.
Movement holders are 20.80 each at our current prices.
Just to confirm our terms: we deliver within five working days of order confirmation.
Gasket sheets are 6 each, any quantity.
Ordered 50 gasket sheets from Brisk Supplies at 6 each, 300 in total — small enough that no approval was needed.
Shop meeting: front counter hours stay 9 to 5; Ines takes Saturday mornings off in August.
A client left a wristwatch for engraving; pick-up will be arranged separately once the work is done.
I want a vintage overhaul push in mid-October — Ines on one bench, Hollis Vance's pocket watch first in the queue. We'll need the Lubek parts in the workshop before it starts.

Got the Lubek request on my desk — I'll review it next week.
Ines called: she's back from holiday and free on both benches from mid-October.
Balance staffs are 21 each at current prices.

Booked the vintage push week for Monday 12 to Friday 16 October: Ines on bench 2, Hollis's pocket watch first in the queue. Lubek delivers five working days after confirmation, so parts ordered this week will land in time.
Second Lubek order placed for the push: 18 balance staffs at 21 each, 378 in total. Over the 350 limit as well, so it goes to Priya for sign-off before confirming.
Told Hollis Vance to collect his pocket watch on Tuesday 20 October at 15:00 — that leaves room for the Lubek confirmation to clear Priya's sign-off after the push week.
While I'm at the conference, a reminder: any parts order above 350 still comes to me for sign-off before you confirm it with the supplier — that includes the two Lubek orders on my desk.

Quick update on sign-offs: from Monday 21 September the threshold for parts orders goes up from 350 to 600. Supplier prices have climbed this year and I don't need to see the smaller orders anymore. Our new price list from 1 October: movement holders 21.60 each and balance staffs 22.40 each. Orders confirmed before then keep their original prices.
See you Tuesday 20 October at three — looking forward to having the old girl ticking again.
Once both Lubek orders are confirmed, the invoice gets paid within 14 days — don't let it slip.
Ines, can you set up the ultrasonic bath before the push week starts?
